reason: We have to move off E-Golf4U once and get it right for 950 members, and two founders with no club live yet is too big a bet for the board. I'd rather pay a bit more for Nexxchange or IntoGolf, which other clubs already run on, than have to explain a failed migration at the members' meeting.
objection: Nobody is actually live on this yet, and our older members won't install a new app. If two people run support and one of them leaves, the club has nothing, and all our tee times, invoices and the bar tab depend on it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season, plus a call with their secretary about how the older members and the migration went, and an escrow or data-export guarantee in the contract.
